roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator and Infection Control Nurse
description: We are seeking a dedicated Staff Development Coordinator and Infection Control Nurse to join a leading skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD. This urgent full-time opportunity offers a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, reflecting your expertise and commitment to quality care.In this dual role, you will be instrumental in both fostering staff growth through comprehensive education programs and ensuring the highest standards of infection prevention and control. Your contributions will directly impact patient safety and the professional development of our team.If you are a passionate RN with a strong background in staff education and infection control, we encourage you to apply. This is an excellent chance to make a significant impact in a supportive environment.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in staff development or nursing education
Minimum of 2 years of experience in infection prevention and control
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations related to long-term care and infection control
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, based on experience.
